subject: pe
title: Team Sports: Football
welcome_lead: 11 against 11 — football is teamwork and strategy on a grass canvas.
meta_desc: KS3 PE: football basics, positions, key rules.
final_note: Pass, move, support — the heart of football.

concepts.def: Game with 2 teams of 11 trying to score.
Only player allowed to use hands in their area.
Player who stops the other team scoring.
Player who links defence and attack.
Player who tries to score goals.
Rule against waiting ahead for a pass.

walkthroughs.body_html: Most teams have a goalkeeper, 4 defenders, 4 midfielders and 2 forwards — formations like 4-4-2 or 4-3-3.
Use feet, head, chest. No hands except for the keeper. Offside stops attackers camping near the goal.
The ball must fully cross the goal line between the posts under the bar. Most goals after 90 minutes wins.
